title: stardust rollout/coverage/blocks.json
description: The dedup unit. One row per DISTINCT block across the site (matched by a signature derived from canon / migrated sections). rollout converts each block to an EDS block once and reuses it across every page that composes it. Records the EDS mapping + delivery status and, on module rows, what the delivered pages show of the block: option classes, variants with stable ids, the code's description and content contract, a base type and the judged purpose, reuse guidance and colour scheme. Owned by stardust:rollout; deploy is never modified. Part of the coverage contract a client reads: strict here because it describes exactly what stardust writes.

variantsSummary.description: The variant explosion over the module rows (one per EDS name): total = their variants, singleUse = those used by exactly one instance, blocks = the rows with at least one variant (the blocks the delivered documents show). An adopter emits one catalog block per variant, so a high singleUse count means many one-off option-class combinations, not reuse. Optional: written since stardust 0.36.x; the workspace manifest recomputes the same figures.

singleUse.description: Variants with exactly one instance across all pages.

blocks.description: Module rows with at least one variant.

inputs.description: Hashes of the files blocks.mjs read (judgement.json, the conversion log, blocks/<n>/<n>.{js,css}), keyed by project-relative POSIX path, so the workspace manifest can refuse coverage older than its inputs.

formatVersion.description: Coverage format version (semver). Before 1.0.0 a release may still change the shape; from 1.0.0 (declared once a client has shipped against it) a minor release only adds fields, clients ignore fields they do not know, and removing or renaming a field is a major release. Writers since stardust 0.34.0 always emit it; files written earlier lack it.

block.description: optionClasses, variants, description, contract and baseType are present on module rows whose EDS name is not default-content (written since stardust 0.34.0); purpose, reuseGuidance and colorScheme only when judged.

kind.description: chrome = header/nav/footer (delivered as fragments); module = brand module; section = reusable section archetype.

signature.description: Stable fingerprint used to match identical block instances across pages for dedup (derived from canon module id or the section's structural signature).

source.description: Canon definition path when the block is canonized, e.g. stardust/canon/modules/<id>.html; `blocks-dir` for a block blocks.mjs registered from blocks/<name>/ (holding <name>.js or <name>.css) that no page's sidecar lists — its usage is counted from the delivered documents like any module row's.

usedByTemplates.description: Template ids of the pages in usedByPages, sorted.

usedByPages.description: Slugs of the pages that use the block, sorted. A module row with an EDS block: the pages whose delivered document holds a record of that block (pages.json delivered.blocks, kind block — the records block-origin.mjs maps); chrome and default-content rows: the pages whose sidecar modules[] declare them. Written this way since stardust 0.36.x; earlier files carried the sidecars' plan for every row and [] for blocks-dir rows.

instanceCount.description: Block instances across usedByPages, counted the same way (a module row with an EDS block: its delivered.blocks records, the sum of variants[].instances; 0 when no document shows it, whatever the sidecars planned).

status.description: `not-delivered` records a block intentionally left undelivered (update-coverage.mjs --block <name> --status not-delivered --reason "<text>"); counted apart in lastRun.blocks.notDelivered, never pending.

edsBlockName.description: Canonical EDS block name this block was converted to (blocks/<name>/). The dedup target. `default-content` records a module mapped to EDS default content (no block needed); such a row is never counted pending, whatever its status.

reason.description: Why the block is intentionally not delivered. Required with status `not-delivered`; any other status removes it.

optionClasses.description: Option classes of the delivered instances plus those the block's CSS styles, unique and sorted.

variants.description: Distinct class combinations of the block in the pages' delivered records, sorted by their joined classes.

variantsSummary.description: Summary of variants[]: total = its length, singleUse = the variants with exactly one instance. An adopter emits one catalog block per variant, so singleUse close to total means one-off option-class combinations an adopter may fold, not reuse. Optional: written beside variants since stardust 0.36.x.

description.description: First sentence of the doc comment in the block's JavaScript, or null.

contract.description: The block's content contract from the conversion log, or null.

baseType.description: Judged base type, else the standard block the name matches, else unknown.

purpose.description: Judged purpose; present only when judged.

reuseGuidance.description: Judged reuse guidance; present only when judged.

colorScheme.description: Judged colour scheme; present only when judged.

pages.description: Number of distinct pages using the variant.

instances.description: Number of instances across all pages.
